result:
Archiving a project now only touches its issues that are still live, and the count it reports is the number actually archived. The existing service and repository tests pass and `tsc` is clean. I didn't add a test for the mixed case (some issues already archived), so that scenario hasn't been run.

The cause was `archiveIssuesForProject` in `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`. It updated every issue in the project, including ones already archived. That overwrote their archive date with today's, which is what pushed the retention sweep out. It also returned every row it touched as the count, so 12 was reported instead of 9. The audit log, the activity summary and the usage listener all use that count. The listener subtracted the inflated number from the meter, which is how it went below the real figure and then negative.

I added the live-issues filter (`livePredicate`) to the update, alongside the existing org and project filters. Issues archived earlier keep their original archive date and aren't counted. Issues in other projects are still excluded by the project filter.

The meter drift was entirely the inflated count, so I made no other code changes. Workspaces that already drifted will stay off until the rollup job runs `recomputeUsage`.
